A '''fortress''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was used by the [[The Warlord's species|alien]] ruler known as [[the Warlord]]. The fortress contained [[Color/Legends|black]] and red towers. A group of [[Eickarie]]s and [[Unit Aurek-Seven]] of the [[Empire of the Hand]] [[Capture of the Warlord|captured]] the Warlord inside the structure.<ref name="FB">''[[Fool's Bargain]]''</ref>
